name: Holographic Stereogram
definition: A type of hologram composed of a series of discrete 2D perspective views of the object scene. An HPO (Horizontal-Parallax-Only) stereogram produces a view-dependent image presenting the corresponding perspective view in each horizontally displaced direction, similar to lenticular or parallax barrier displays.
summary: A holographic stereogram is a computer-generated hologram combining discrete 2D perspective views to produce horizontal parallax, restricting vertical parallax to create a view-dependent 3D image.
